Piper paper-cup handover — 79 curated episodes
	

Task: Pick up the paper cup with the gripper, place it in the person’s hand, and then open the gripper.
This LeRobot v2.1 dataset contains 79 episodes, 38,948 data frames and 158 RGB videos at 30 FPS, 640×480. Episode indices are 0–78, with continuous global frame indices 0–38,947. All episodes are in the training split.

author: Samisaliveagain
description:
Piper Hexagonal Bolt Insertion
	

Task: Pick up the hexagonal bolt and place it in the matching opening.
100 saved teleoperated episodes, 104,172 synchronized frames,
and approximately 57.87 minutes of data at nominal 30 FPS.
The robot is an AgileX Piper follower controlled using a seven-servo Piper leader.
Data is stored in LeRobot v3.0 format for imitation learning.
